user_problem: Peer review needs a bounded sequence that produces useful evidence without asking students to judge personal qualities.
unique_output: A timed protocol with artifact checks, evidence stems, author questions, revision choice, and disagreement handling.
required_input: Assignment prompt, rubric, review duration, allowed feedback scope, and submission format.
critical_rule: Confine feedback to the artifact and supplied criteria; reviewers must distinguish observations from suggestions.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is reviewing-code-changes; this designs learner-to-learner artifact review rather than technical code review.
acceptance_scenario: Input is a 200-word explanation assessed for claim and two examples, with ten review minutes. Output allocates checks for claim and examples, supplies evidence stems, and ends with the author selecting one revision.
